srList.sentence: Acquisition of medical imaging data for standardization into R-CDM The randomly sampled medical imaging data (41.7 TB; 87203226 images from 2801360 cases), about 10% of the whole dataset, from Ajou University Hospital were approved for usage in research purposes.
